name: Pinned apps open at once
author: wizard
description: A home-screen app icon opens the app straight away from the app list this device already knows, instead of showing Loading app while Wizard asks your box for its settings and app list one after the other. The box's fresh list still checks it a moment later, so a renamed, moved or removed app is still followed. Wizard also reads your launcher settings at the same time as its other startup read.
